title: Chapter 753
paragraphs: Chapter 753
Episode 185. The Remaining People (3)
"Are you saying that you are fading...?"
"That's right. The binding force of the soul energy that makes up us is continuously weakening. It must be because the Demon God has disappeared."
"Six months at the shortest, a year at the longest. That should be the limit of the time we can exist."
Alpen and Tasha said.
Jin's heart ached at their words and he narrowed his eyebrows. Balas laughed as if it was not a big deal.

"Hahaha! Great-grandson, your soft heart reminds me of your father's baby days. Don't worry about us disappearing. After all, aren't all people destined to die eventually? Rather, the three of us, who have long been dead, have been given extra time, so it's more like a blessing. Just think of us as elderly people living on borrowed time."
"57th generation. Well, I'm not aging though......"
"Elderly on borrowed time, hmm. It doesn't seem to be a very comforting phrase for the deputy clan chief."
"I'll see if there's a way to extend the time you three have left."
"Yeah, yeah. But don't try too hard. Those who need to go, need to go. Anyway, we will do our best to support you while we exist."
"Thank you, great-grandfather."
The existence of the past clan chiefs was a double-edged sword.
While it was true that the three of them added great strength to the now-shrunken Runcandel, it also made them a potential target for other factions.
It was Jin and the temporary alliance who clearly saved the world from the Demon God.
However, the place where the Demon God was born was also 'Runcandel.'
There were no few saints who were anxious about that fact.
Given the fact that the past clan chiefs who have been resurrected through soul energy are still here, it is a perfect condition for someone to provoke Runcandel as evil.
"The only thing I'm worried about is the other factions tripping over the three of us. Probably cunning and sly Zipple will do something like that."
The past clan chiefs were aware of that fact.
"During my absence, were there any signs of this?"
"None so far."
"Then, it should be fine for a while. If Zipple or Kinzelo are not acting recklessly, it's because they fear me."
The incarnation of the God and the power of Murakan displayed during the Demon God war.

Of course, Jin could now be called the World's Greatest Swordsman on his own strength, but the two things that the other forces most checked after the dissolution of the alliance were exactly these two.
Jin still couldn't single-handedly overpower the major forces with his own personal martial power.
Even if there was damage from the Demon God War, the enemies have become stronger than when there were conflicts.

"Probably the other factions, especially Zipple, would have wanted to attack us as soon as the Demon God War ended. If they hadn't seen the fusion with the God and Murakan, they would definitely have done so."
"In other words, whether you can freely use those two powers. They're standing still because they can't confirm it."
"That's correct. Naturally, I can't use those two powers at any time. They both have significant constraints. The enemies are probably anticipating this, but they won't move until they're certain."
"What if Zipple attacks us right now? What do you think will happen?"
"What is the extent of the damage to Zipple?"
"There were no deaths among the superhuman ranks, and I've received reports that more than 70% of the fleet has been destroyed."
"Then it's not a huge damage. All of it is recoverable over time, and perhaps the fleet has already been produced."
Zipple had managed to recover hundreds of ships in just two months while the Demon God War was going on.
It meant there were at least a few more shipyards at a level similar to the Sota Desert.
"What do you think will happen if Zipple attacks us right now?"
"We're unlikely to win. Even if we manage to hold out, the clan will inevitably suffer catastrophic damage. How is the damage on Kinzelo's side?"
"About the same as Zipple. None of the key demons are dead, but many of the fleet and masterpieces have been lost."
Jin predicted that Kinzelo had also started to recover the damage.
Rebuilding a fleet wouldn't be too difficult with the enhanced powers of Orgal and Bubar's abilities.
"If Zipple and Kinzelo join forces and attack us now, we're doomed."
"That's right."
Currently, Jin is unable to use the God Fusion again.
There was a lack of materials to recreate the wave tracking synchronization device.
Murakan could be summoned if needed, but that alone would be a gamble.
If Murakan reappears, Misha will inevitably have to fill his place for a while, which means there's a chance Elona Zipple's seal could be broken.
"Do you need to bluff that you can still use the powers you used in the Demon God War?"
When Tasha spoke, Jin laughed softly and shook his head.
"In my opinion, it would be better to openly reveal that I can't use them."
"Why?"

"Because it will confuse them. If I try too hard to hide it, they will be certain, but if I expose my weaknesses, they will doubt it. 'Isn't he pretending to be unable to summon the God and Murakan, trying to provoke the rest of the factions to break the inviolability treaty, and then justify war?'... like that."
"What if the enemies really take that bait?"

"Even if that happens, Kinzelo and Zipple can't casually join forces. As soon as one of them starts to move, we can just reach out too. Besides, we have one card each that the two factions want the most."
Bale and Valeria.

"As far as I know, neither Zipple nor Kinzelo have a card as valuable as those two. If they want to form an alliance in this situation and end one side, they would rather want to join hands with us. Either way."
"Ha, unlike Zipple, Kinzelo doesn't have centuries-old grudges with us. And I've heard that they've always been showing goodwill towards you."
Of course, he had no intention of using the two as negotiation cards.
They were just people who could upset the enemies by slightly shaking them in his hands.
In the first place, Jin made the judgement that there was no possibility for the enemies to form an alliance.
He judged that they would only form a real alliance when Runcandel became the most dominant force.

"However, there will be political operations to use the origin of the Demon God and the three of you to make us the axis of evil. No matter how much public sentiment I secured since I was a probationary knight, I can't help it in this part."
"I don't know about the 20th and 21st generations, but we are a family that doesn't care about such things. A faction that doesn't care about the world's attention, that's Runcandel."
"I do care, Grandfather."
"Then you're right! You're the head of the family!"

"We will also conduct operations. We will officially announce the record mage, Valeria Hister, to the world and plan to fully disclose all records about this war to the public. It's true that the Demon God born in Runcandel caused damage to the world, but I will clarify that the intention of me and my colleagues who resolved this war did not stem from a desire to be the losers of the world."
"We also need to proceed with compensation for the damage."
"I've been continuously receiving official documents, 57th."
"It will require a lot of funds. We'll address that issue with the money we've saved and with the help of the empire."
This was already discussed with Dante before the decisive battle.
Dante had kept the massive reserve funds of the royal family left behind by Amir Vermont intact.
But no matter how much money was spent, the emotional pain of those who had already lost their families could never be compensated.
The same was true for the lives of the dead.
At that fact, Jin briefly closed his eyes tightly.
Jin felt a heavy sense of responsibility towards them.
What the family had done was now what Jin had done.
Even though it was something that had happened just before Jin became the head of the family by someone else, the responsibility was entirely Jin's.
In addition to financial compensation, Jin was also planning to provide a foundation for life.
He wanted to provide the place for the war refugees as much as the population of Huphester had been lost.

Of course, it wouldn't be easy. Even aside from resource issues, the land of Huphester already had a history of being steeped in chaos and destruction, so there wouldn't be many people wanting to move here.
However, when he discussed these thoughts with the previous heads of the family, the responses he received were completely unexpected.

"Requests for immigration are already pouring in endlessly. You said you're paying attention to public sentiment? I can immediately see what kind of life you've lived so far. Even though the world has become like this because of the Demon God born from our family, there are many refugees who are looking only for you."
"......Really? Great-grandfather."
"Yes. We said we never cared about the world's attention, but in reality, this great-grandfather has seen and felt a lot."
Demon God, as spoken by Runcandel, who only pursued power.
Jin's Runcandel would be very different from that.
"We have been holding off all the approvals since you were unconscious. It seems like it would be good to order the knights to accept them immediately."
Jin was silent for a moment, thinking about their situation.
Due to this incident, Runcandel certainly took more from ordinary people than it gave.
Yet people are still coming, hoping in 'Jin Runcandel'.
In this unstable era that started to be shrouded in the clouds of war right after the end of the Demon God war, Jin was becoming the light for many people.
Jin is different from others.
He is different from the leaders of other major forces, and different from other power-holders. If so, he can definitely lead this world to a better state.
As much as there were people who felt repulsive towards Runcandel, there were also many people who perceived Jin in such a way.
"Yes. I'll have to accept the reports from the knights and make a statement to the world."
"What's next?"
Jin smiled softly and answered like this.
"I have to monitor the enemies' movements, rescue the remaining knights, and find the old steward of the family to bring him back."
